title: Customers Bank CEO Sam Sidhu to Present at TD Cowen 2026 Financials & Fintech Conference
summary: Stay informed with the latest news, updates, and announcements from Customers Bank. Browse our press releases to gain insights into our growth, products, services, and innovative initiatives that shape our organization.
body_markdown:
WEST READING, Pa.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Customers Bank](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.customersbank.com%2F&esheet=54642204&newsitemid=20261116084009&lan=en-US&anchor=Customers+Bank&index=1&md5=362d92b27e04b60f5166cfabe88d490e) , a subsidiary of Customers Bancorp, Inc. (NYSE: CUBI), will present at the **TD Cowen 2026 Financials & Fintech Conference** on November 17, 2026. Sam Sidhu, president and CEO, is scheduled to speak to analysts and investors at 9:30 a.m. ET.


A live audio webcast of the presentation will be available[here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevent.summitcast.com%2Fview%2FkUADT54t3KLrdMSeEKPHuG%2Fguest_book%3Fsession_id%3DXFS944AHcfTeKqtbuAMfYy&esheet=54642204&newsitemid=20261116084009&lan=en-US&anchor=here&index=3&md5=05a0e010ebfa9b2b86b32f2a8232d20a) . A replay will be available following the presentation.


**Institutional Background**


Customers Bancorp, Inc. (NYSE: CUBI) is one of the nation’s top-performing banking companies with more than $27 billion in assets, making it one of the 80 largest bank holding companies in the U.S. Customers Bank’s commercial and consumer clients benefit from a full suite of technology-enabled tailored product experiences delivered by best-in-class customer service distinguished by a Single Point of Contact approach. In addition to traditional lines such as C&I, commercial real estate, and residential and personal lending, Customers Bank also provides a number of national corporate banking services to clients in businesses including: fund finance, venture banking, healthcare, mortgage finance, and equipment finance.


Major accolades include:


- Named a Top Performing Bank by *American Banker* for six consecutive years (2021-2026), including the #1 spot in 2024 among midsize banks ($10B to $50B in assets)
- No. 45 out of the 100 largest publicly traded banks in 2026 Forbes Best Banks list
- Net Promoter Score of 81 compared to industry average of 41


A member of the Federal Reserve System with deposits insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation, Customers Bank is an equal opportunity lender. Learn more:[https://www.customersbank.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.customersbank.com&esheet=54642204&newsitemid=20261116084009&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.customersbank.com&index=2&md5=0086baf179902f2f21619c2ce98cd6d2) .
